Following this, the war transitioned to more conventional fighting in the south and east of Ukraine. In a televised address, Russian president Vladimir Putin announced the invasion, calling it a "special military operation". In late 2021, Russia massed troops near Ukraine's borders and issued demands to the West including a ban on Ukraine ever joining the NATO military alliance.
